SELECT p.product_id AS productId, p.product_name AS productName, p.product_stock AS productStock, p.product_unit AS productUnit, p.pic_thumb AS productPicThumb, p.product_sn AS productSn, p.product_tsn AS productTsn, p.product_type AS productType, p.cost_price AS productCost, p.card_group_id AS cardGroupId, ps.cost_price AS costPrice, ps.sku_id as skuId, ps.sku_value AS productSkuName, ps.sku_stock AS productSkuStock, ps.cost_price AS productSkuCost FROM product p LEFT JOIN product_sku ps ON p.product_id = ps.product_id WHERE p.shop_id = #{productStockDTO.shopId} AND p.vendor_id is null
AND p.product_type = #{productStockDTO.productType}
AND (p.product_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{productStockDTO.keyword},'%') or ps.sku_value LIKE CONCAT('%',#{productStockDTO.keyword},'%') or ps.sku_tsn = #{productStockDTO.keyword} or p.product_tsn = #{productStockDTO.keyword})
ORDER BY p.add_time

SELECT p.product_id AS productId, p.product_name AS productName, p.shop_id AS shopId, p.product_unit AS productUnit, p.pic_thumb AS productPicThumb, p.product_sn AS productSn, p.product_tsn AS productTsn, p.product_type AS productType, p.card_group_id AS cardGroupId, p.product_stock AS productStock, ps.sku_id AS skuId, ps.sku_value AS productSkuName, ps.sku_stock AS skuStock, sp.store_product_id AS storeProductId, sp.shop_id AS storeShopId, sp.product_stock AS storeStock, sps.sku_stock AS storeSkuStock, sps.store_product_sku_id AS storeProductSkuId, sps.product_sku_id AS storeSkuId, CASE WHEN ps.sku_id is not null THEN ps.sku_stock WHEN p.shop_id = 0 AND sp.store_product_id IS NOT NULL THEN sp.product_stock WHEN p.shop_id = 0 AND sps.store_product_sku_id IS NOT NULL THEN sps.sku_stock ELSE p.product_stock END AS currentProductStock, CASE WHEN ps.sku_id is not null THEN ps.cost_price WHEN p.shop_id = 0 AND sp.store_product_id IS NOT NULL THEN null WHEN p.shop_id = 0 AND sps.store_product_sku_id IS NOT NULL THEN null ELSE p.cost_price END AS costPrice, CASE WHEN sp.store_product_id is not null THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS distributeProduct FROM product p LEFT JOIN product_sku ps ON p.product_id = ps.product_id LEFT JOIN store_product sp ON sp.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN store_product_sku sps ON sps.product_id = p.product_id WHERE (p.shop_id = #{productStockDTO.shopId} OR sp.shop_id = #{productStockDTO.shopId}) AND p.vendor_id is null
AND p.product_type = #{productStockDTO.productType}
AND (p.product_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{productStockDTO.keyword},'%') or ps.sku_value LIKE CONCAT('%',#{productStockDTO.keyword},'%') or ps.sku_tsn LIKE CONCAT('%',#{productStockDTO.keyword},'%') or p.product_tsn LIKE CONCAT('%',#{productStockDTO.keyword},'%'))
GROUP BY CASE WHEN p.shop_id = 0 AND sps.store_product_id IS NOT NULL THEN sps.store_product_id WHEN p.shop_id = 0 AND sp.store_product_id IS NOT NULL THEN sp.store_product_id WHEN sp.store_product_id IS NOT NULL THEN sp.store_product_id ELSE p.product_id END ORDER BY p.add_time
SELECT sku_price FROM product_sku WHERE product_id = #{productId} ORDER BY sku_price ASC
SELECT MIN(sku_price) AS min_price FROM product_sku WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND is_enabled = 1
